title: Measuring the depth of multidimensional poverty with ordinal data
abstract: arXiv:2603.15149v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Standard multidimensional poverty gap measures are seldom applied because they require cardinal indicators. This paper proposes a positional poverty gap index that captures the depth of deprivations even when indicators are ordinal. Drawing on the fuzzy set literature, the method scores each deprived individual by their positional distance from the top of the empirical distribution of each indicator, normalized by the same distance for the most deprived individual. An axiomatic characterization shows that, once deprivation is built up additively from pairwise comparisons of achievements, this positional depth score is the only one consistent with ordinal data. Within the Alkire-Foster counting framework, the measure preserves the identification and aggregation structure and, under a fixed reference distribution, satisfies the main axiomatic properties. translated_title: 基于序数数据测量多维贫困深度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.15149v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：标准的多维贫困缺口测量方法很少被应用，因为它们需要基数指标。本文提出了一种位置性贫困缺口指数，即使在指标为序数的情况下也能捕捉剥夺的深度。借鉴模糊集文献，该方法通过每个被剥夺个体在每个指标的经验分布中相对于顶部的位置距离进行评分，并以最被剥夺个体的相同距离进行归一化。一个公理化特征表明，一旦剥夺从成就的成对比较中加法构建，这种位置性深度评分是唯一与序数数据一致的。在Alkire-Foster计数框架内，该测量保持了识别和聚合结构，并在固定参考分布下满足主要公理化性质。结果是一个有意义的、与政策相关的多维贫困深度指数。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于序数数据的位置性贫困缺口指数，通过个体在经验分布中的相对位置衡量剥夺深度，并证明其是唯一与序数数据一致且满足公理化性质的深度测量方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a positional poverty gap index for ordinal data that measures deprivation depth via relative positions in empirical distributions, uniquely consistent with ordinal data and satisfying axiomatic properties within the Alkire-Foster framework.
